Re-check these debrid records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- debrid/egifts24 $.tooling: Page says only account login/creation for redemption. Does not say 'browser checkout' nor that TorBox redemption is a support ticket (TorBox page says 'contact support', a different capture).
- debrid/softstore-alldebrid-12m $.price_per_tb_month: Page prints $900.00 with no currency; the claim labels it USD while also saying currency is not printed. USD is not stated by the source.
- debrid/transload-me $.limits[0].value: Home-page 'свыше 1 МБ/сек' is supported, but the 'Download speed up to 5 Mbit/sec' per-host-page part is not in this capture.
- debrid/takelink-org $.limits[0].value: Probe record shows HTTP 502, one attempt ('attempts': 1), not HTTP 530 on two attempts. Also says nothing on domain ownership.
- debrid/aradeb $.reliability_note: Trial 90 days and donor permanent key are supported, but the page does not say both dependencies must hold or that the addon can stop resolving; only 'Donations help cover private trackers'.
- debrid/bedrive-ru $.free_tier.stated: Page lists premium benefits only; free-tier ads, wait, limited simultaneous downloads and limited speed are not stated.
- debrid/aradeb $.category: Page supports Arabic catalogs and own paid Debrid. It lists four providers (TorBox, AllDebrid, Premiumize, Real-Debrid), not just Real-Debrid or TorBox, and does not say streams come from private trackers.
- debrid/egifts24 $.chaining: Page lists eGifts24 ZAR as accepted. It does not say this is the only documented path among debrid providers, nor anything about African currencies or foreign cards.
- debrid/takelink-org $.free_tier.stated: 2023 archive capture shows a lottery page. It does not show that the domain was a paid multi-host straightener, nor that it serves unrelated content or the origin is silent today.
- debrid/softstore-alldebrid-12m $.binding_note: Page states the one-IP rule and blocking on anomalies. It does not say the account dies the first time two buyers open it from different addresses, nor that it is sold to multiple buyers.
- debrid/transload-me $.tooling: 24-hour validity and the account API (term 8) are in the terms; the output being a transload.me download a download manager can take is not.
- debrid/transload-me $.tooling: Email-only is supported, but the value is about tooling: browser form, 24h links, download manager. The email span does not say those; download-manager part appears nowhere.
- debrid/egifts24 $.interface_detail: Source describes account login for redemption. It does not say checkout delivers a code by email nor that TorBox side is an email to support.
- debrid/egifts24 $.limits_note: The exact phrase 'Valid for use in South Africa only' is not in the capture. Redemption-within-SA is stated; that the rail is closed to non-SA buyers and TorBox is not is inference.
- debrid/egifts24 $.identity_cost.detail: eGifts24 account part is supported; the TorBox account credit part is not in this capture (it is in the TorBox article).
- debrid/takelink-org $.category: Capture shows a lottery page in 2023; it does not say the domain was a Russian multi-host straightener.
- debrid/takelink-org $.reliability_note: Probe shows 502 only; nothing on phishing, old recommendations or unrelated content.
- debrid/bedrive-ru $.limits[0].value: Premium page lists 'Без ожидания' and possible max speed; free-tier limits are not stated, so 'premium removes both' of free-tier wait and limited speed is not proved.
- debrid/transload-me $.limits[0].value: Terms page has link validity, no download speed figures (no 1 MB/s, no 5 Mbit/sec).
- debrid/softstore-alldebrid-12m $.limits_note: Clause supported; 'sold to an unknown number of buyers' is not stated by the page.
- debrid/egifts24 $.reliability_note: Value/legitimacy check is stated. 'Days of delay' is not stated, and the non-returnable term is on the eGifts24 page, not this article.
- debrid/transload-me $.interface_detail: Home capture has 'Загрузка в один клик: вам достаточно вставить ссылку' but nothing on an account API (that is in the terms capture), nor that documentation was not found.
- debrid/takelink-org $.interface_detail: Capture shows a Chinese lottery page (only a ripple.com privacy link in a cookie dialog). Not shown: copied Ripple marketing text, expired-and-re-registered domain.
